notes.title: Wild Country – Now Available in Simplified and Traditional Chinese! 🎴
notes.content:
We're excited to share that Wild Country is now fully localized in both Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese! This is a big milestone for us—and one we've been quietly working toward for some time.

Players around the world can now experience the full adventure of Big Sky in their language of choice—whether you're crafting your perfect deck, exploring the bustling world of Big Sky, or challenging rivals online.

Here’s what awaits you:

 🌿 A large pool of cards to collect, learn, and master.
 🌿 A cast of quirky characters and a world full of charm and surprises.
 🌿 Easy-to-learn gameplay with rich, strategic depth for all skill levels.
 🌿 Online multiplayer for friendly duels and fierce competition.


To celebrate, Wild Country is 20% off until May 11, 2025 — don’t miss it!

Bringing Wild Country to more players has always been part of the vision. Thanks to your support, that vision keeps growing. We’re so grateful you're here—and we can’t wait to welcome even more players to the wild, wonderful world of Big Sky.


[hr][/hr]

👋 UNTIL NEXT TIME!


Keep exploring, keep discovering, and most importantly—have fun.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!


Beck Snow ✌️
Design Director on Wild Country 🦝🏡

Below you will find the patch notes for Ver. 1.0.0.5.0!

 We’ve given the controls a full overhaul! While there’s still a bit of polish to come, gameplay now feels much smoother on both keyboard and controller. Give it a go and let us know what you think!

 Added a "Show Stats" button to the match UI to help you remember it's there.
 Removed the Main Menu shortcut from the settings menu—it's still accessible via the top bar.
 Updated the Input tab in the Settings Menu to reflect the new control scheme.
 Replaced the intro trailer with a new, updated one.
 Pressing Esc now closes all open menus and popups—clean and quick.
 Fixed an issue where double-tapping Tab (or pressing right twice on the D-pad) would incorrectly open the Mayor’s Office.

notes.title: The Road Ahead
notes.content:
Hey, folks.

It’s been a while since our last update, and for good reason—the team took a well-earned break over the winter to recharge and step away from our screens for a bit. Now, we’re back, recharged, refocused, and ready to shape the next chapter of Wild Country.

A lot has been happening behind the scenes. We’ve been hard at work crafting new challenges, unexpected twists, and maybe even a few surprises you won’t see coming. We’re not quite ready to share everything just yet, but trust us—it’ll be worth the wait.

Here’s a glimpse of what’s ahead:

🌟 Regular Updates – Starting this Friday, we’ll be rolling out updates every two weeks to keep the game fresh and exciting.
🌟 2025 Roadmap –  A closer look at what’s coming next—including Steam Deck support, localization updates, and console news—is coming soon™. Got requests? Let us know!
🌟 Steam Spring Sale – Wild Country is hitting its lowest price yet during the Spring Sale! The perfect time to grab a copy for a friend and battle it out online.

Version 1.0.0.2.0 Coming Soon
Your feedback continues to shape the future of Wild Country. Keep the ideas coming on the Steam Community page or our Discord server—we’re always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

Until Next Time
Keep exploring, keep discovering, and most importantly—have fun.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 6 & 7 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Adventurers, we’ve made it to the last of our daily updates for launch week! 

From here on, updates will roll out weekly every Friday, giving us more time to fine-tune, polish, and deliver exciting new improvements. 🚀

This update clears out the clutter and smooths the edges: Amos has finally settled into the right spot 🗺️, Sandy’s stopped her endless chatter (phew! 😅), and those vanishing ties and badges? Back where they belong! 🧑‍🎩✨ We’ve also welcomed more tutorial NPCs to help new players hit the ground running and brought back the match timer ⏱️ to keep your online battles fast and focused.

But wait, there’s more! 🌟 We’re working on a roadmap to share what we’re cooking up next 🍳 and what you can get excited about in the weeks to come. Stay tuned—we’re just getting started, and it’s going to be a wild ride! 🎢

Full patch notes below:

[hr][/hr]
🏡 MATCH CHANGES
Gameplay

⌛ Timers are back! Online matches now have a timer to ensure games stay quick and competitive.


⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES
Battles

You can no longer face Amos before learning the basics from Hawthorne. He’ll now wait his turn.
Amos was mistakenly hanging out at The Entrance. He’s been moved to his proper place in Spring Valley.

Conversations

CeCe and NaNa have joined The Entrance, chatting (or squawking?) about their favorite new movie. 🍿
Six new tutorial NPCs have been added to The Entrance to explain game mechanics and tips for new players. Three more tutorial NPCs have been added to Spring Valley.
Sandy was accidentally repeating herself during conversations. This has been fixed, so she’ll keep things fresh now.

Quests

Fantastaco has been rebuilt from the ground up and is now a fully functional quest—time to get delivering! 🌮
It’s easier to understand who’s working for Bob the Job at the Lumbermill versus who’s just hanging out. We’ve updated the setting with clearer environmental storytelling.


🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS

Competitors and quest givers in The Entrance and Spring Valley are now correctly tracked on your map. 🗺️
Cosmetic items (like ties, makeup, scars, and badges) are no longer disappearing or acting strangely—they’re fixed and ready to show off! 💄✨
Online Play & Campaign highlights weren’t displaying properly in the second and third mayor’s offices. This has been corrected.
A new tutorial popup explains the mulligan phase during your second match (vs. Robbie), so you’ll know exactly how it works. 🔄
Ranger Tom suggested you change your deck, but it wasn’t clear how to do it. We’ve added a helpful popup to guide you after his advice. 🃏


[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on our Discord server—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

Thanks for an incredible launch week, and here’s to the exciting adventures ahead! 🎊

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 5 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 5 of post-launch updates!

We’re in the home stretch of our first week, with just two more days of daily patches to go before the initial release week wraps up. It’s been amazing to see your creativity and strategy in action—every build, every battle, and every bit of feedback helps us make the game even better.

Thanks for being part of this journey with us! Now, let’s dive into what’s new in today’s update: 🎉


[hr][/hr]
🏡 MATCH CHANGES
Gameplay

🏠 Inspecting a building at the start of your turn no longer freezes your hand. The game will now let you inspect in peace!


⚔️ CAMPAIGN CHANGES
Battles

🛡️ Winning the MJ and Nate quest will now properly end the battle without endless repeats or false loss messages. 
🐦 Benjamin Bird has finished chatting about his latest obsession -  online play - and is ready to face you in a proper duel. Prepare to bring your A-game! 🎮
🏆 Repeated battles with Nate, Jellybean, and Kensington are no longer possible. One duel is all you need—save the farming for Timberton.🌲

Conversations

🕵️ Skip is no longer pretending to be Benjamin Bird. Everyone’s identities are back in order!

Quests

🍋 Bertie will now properly recognize when you’ve collected the cups for the 'Lemonade is Life' quest, so you can finally complete it. 🥤

Items

🪝 Two messages in bottles (Galactic Report Log #327-A & DESTROY AFTER READING) now have their descriptions restored!


🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS

🐻 Billy Bearclaw now has a collider and properly interacts with the world around him.
Graham’s transformation into a beaver is complete—his character model now reflects his true self. 🦫
🧍‍♀️ Lucy Claws and MJ no longer overlap with other characters. Everyone’s got their space back.
🎚️ The key items scrollbar is fully functional again, making it easier to navigate your inventory.
🆙 There was a bit of confusion with level progress not syncing correctly between the Player Profile and the Mayor’s Office. Now the level-up bar updates perfectly across all screens!🌟


[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on our Discord server—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 4 of post-launch updates!

Happy Thanksgiving to all who celebrate! 🦃

It’s been awesome seeing the creative builds and clever strategies you’ve come up with so far—you’re already surprising us in the best ways. Your feedback and enthusiasm keep us motivated as we keep making the game better and better.

Let’s check out what’s new in this update!: 🎉


[hr][/hr]

Cards & Card Packs

Rebel Riot

Statuses

Battles

Pico was giving everyone the silent treatment, making battles impossible. He’s ready to fight again—good luck! 💥

Quests

Player level in the Mayor’s Office wasn’t lining up with the Match Results Screen. We’ve fixed it so everything matches perfectly now! ✔️

notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 3 of post-launch updates!

A huge shoutout to everyone sharing bug reports on Discord—you’re helping us iron out the kinks and make Wild Country shine. And to those leaving reviews on our page, thank you! Your support and feedback mean the world and help us grow even stronger. ✨

Curious about what’s improved today? Let’s dive into the details below! 🎉

Cards & Card Packs

The Apple Card was incorrectly giving $20 instead of the $50 shown on the card. This bug has been squashed, and the card is now as juicy as it claims! 🍎💵

Collection

When you added and removed a card from a deck, your card count sneakily went up by one each time. Not anymore—back to honest collecting!

Items

Litter League had a bug that made things messy. We’ve temporarily disabled it while we tidy it up. 🗑️✨

The scroll bar in the "Key Items" section of the Collection book is now working as intended. 📜
MJ and Captain Bayler were overlapping in the game world. They’ve agreed to give each other some space. 🧍‍♂️↔️🧍‍♂️
Pepper was incorrectly giving out rewards before being battled. This has been fixed—no more freebies! 🎁

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 2 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome back, adventurers, to Day 2 of post-launch updates!

Thanks to your sharp eyes and helpful feedback, we’ve been squashing bugs, polishing features, and making everything a little more fun for your journey ahead. Every step forward is a step toward making the Wild Country the best it can be!

Ready to see what’s been improved today? Let’s dive into the details below!

[hr][/hr]
🎮 SYSTEM CHANGES

You can now open the map by pressing the 'M' button.


⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES
Battles

Fixed two issues with buildings featuring a construction timer: 
- Countdown timers now count down correctly
- Timers disappear as intended once they hit zero, allowing construction to complete smoothly.


Conversations

Nicky & Kevin have stopped repeating themselves. We all love a good story, but once is enough!
Kensington, Matilda, & Nicky now let you battle them as intended.
Snickerdoodle is ready to chat and challenge you to a race—better start stretching!
Pico & Gorp no longer begin their conversations with error text (they promise to use real words now).
The following characters now have functional dialogue and are ready to chat:
Meatball, Ranger Tom, Gorton Hinge, Red Herring, Jet Valentine, Stefan, Jellybean, The Captains, The Pirates, MJ, Nate Laboto, Natalie, Benjamin Bird, Pepper, Sandy, Tony Galore, Bob the Job, Donnie, Kevin, and Flippers.


Quests

Defeating Poppy will now complete her quest as intended.
'Camping Sucks', 'Sad Pancakes', and 'Lemonade is Life' can now be completed. 
Round 4 of 'Journey to Sun City' has been fixed. Speak to Ranger Tom to progress to Round 5.


Minigames

'Dash Hound Derby' has now been fixed! You can now Race Snickerdoodle in Spring Valley.


🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS

Fixed an issue with bear models where their eyes bulged unexpectedly.
Adjusted scrolling boundaries during matches to reduce sensitivity—You can now interact with the UI without the camera scrolling!
Improved text readability for the 'Confirm' text during the mulligan phase.
Collectible popups now scale correctly with text length, ensuring no more overflow or messy displays.


[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! 

Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on our Discord server—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: 🌟 DAY 1 PATCH NOTES 🌟
notes.content:
Welcome, adventurers, to your first official update post-launch! 

We've been hard at work ironing out quirks, fixing typos, and making the Wild Country even wilder. This is just the beginning—we'll be rolling out daily patches to keep improving the game and ensuring your journey gets better and better every step of the way.

Ready to see what's new? Dive in below!

[hr][/hr]
✨ NEW FEATURES

The "Unstuck Me!" button in the Extras tab (Settings Menu) teleports you back to The Entrance if you get stuck. No more awkward cliff-hanging moments—literally!
Say goodbye to guessing games! We added card information popups to the mulligan phase to help you make informed decisions on the cards you may not be as familiar with! These were previously bound to the Collection and during matches.


🎮 SYSTEM CHANGES
CARDS & CARD PACKS

Fixed an issue that prevented rare card packs from being opened. They should now function as intended, so you can enjoy your well-earned rewards without a hitch!


⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES
Conversations & Quests

Jellybean, Kevin, and Birdie weren't feeling too chatty. We've fixed their dialogue, and now they're ready to spill the tea.
Mystic Mike was caught repeating himself—classic Mystic Mike! We gave him a nudge, and he's now more mysterious than ever!
Items

The missing description was added to the "I Got In" Collectible.


🛠️ OTHER FIXES & TWEAKS

Minor typos in Jet Valentine's dialogue and the intro paragraph have been resolved. 
Paco and Natalie shared the same location. Natalie has now relocated to Camp Oaknut for some well-deserved breathing room.
Spooky Steve was showing some concerning behavior. He's left the Canyon for now, but don't worry—he'll haunt us again soon. 👻


[hr][/hr]
That's all for now, adventurers! Keep exploring, keep discovering, and keep having fun. As always, let us know if you run into more weirdness over on our Discord server—we're always listening (and so is Mystic Mike).

notes.title: Play Our Demo During Steam Deck Builders Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, Deck Building Fans!

We’re Lost Native, the developers of Wild Country, and we hope you’re enjoying the demo for our CCG meets City Building Blend! We wanted to take a little time to tell you what else you can expect in the final game.

- A full campaign with new areas of the map unlocking as you progress
- More cards to unlock and add to your deck!
- Full deck customization 
- Full character customization with a choice of animals
- Online play, both ranked and unranked

The game will be coming right here to Steam and Nintendo Switch, so there are a few places to jump back into Big Sky Canyon. Also, be sure to join our Discord, as that’s going to be the first place to hear about upcoming multiplayer tests! 

We’re not far from release, so we’d really appreciate it, if you enjoyed the demo, giving the game a cheeky add to your wishlist! 

Thanks again for playing the demo, and be sure to tell a friend who you think might like it!

- The Lost Native Team

notes.title: December Update Video
notes.content:
Over on our YouTube Channel, we've posted our first development update video. As we're heading into the New Year, we wanted to look back at what we've been up to and look forward to what's still to come for Wild Country! 

[previewyoutube=19AJsvMUD_s;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to show you more and let you in to play a little more of Wild Country before our launch in 2024!

Until then, keep it friendly!

- The Lost Native Team

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Wild Country!
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

2023 has been a big year for us here at Lost Native, but before it ends, we’re hunkering down and enjoying the holiday season! The whole team is away until the start of the new year, and while we can't promise we won't end up thinking of cool things to add to Wild Country, we at least intend to chill, play video games, and eat good food!

2024, now that’s going to be a big one! Wild Country will be released, and on that road, we have several stops along the way where we can show you some very cool stuff! 

Be sure to follow our socials, join our Discord, and keep an eye on our YouTube channel! 

From all of us here at Lost Native, have a great holiday season, and we can’t wait to show you more of Wild Country in 2024!

- The Lost Native Team

notes.title: Our Demo is Back Online for Turn-Based Carnival!
notes.content:
You read that right, our demo is back online and available to download today until October 21st as a part of the Turn-Based Carnival! 

Be sure to let us know what you think about the demo, and if you want to discuss it a bit more, you can head to our Discord and chat with us over there!

Have fun in Big Sky Canyon!

- The Lost Native Team

notes.title: Play Our Demo Today During Next Fest!
notes.content:
The Wild Country demo is available RIGHT NOW as part of the Steam Next Fest! 

Head to the store page and click Download Demo to dive into Big Sky Canyon and begin your adventure!

This demo will give you a bitesize sample of what Wild Country has to offer. Within the demo, you can:


 Learn the ropes of the genre-blending card game Wild Country.
 Customize your character.
 Create and modify your own deck.
 Explore a small section of Big Sky Canyon.
 Get to know the locals and challenge some to battle. 


If you enjoy the demo, please consider wishlisting the game and telling anyone you think might enjoy it to check it out. We can’t wait to show you more as the months go on towards launch! 

Stay wild and keep it friendly, 

The Lost Native Team
